cohort: Pregnant women in Porto Alegre, Brazil, enrolled in two different periods: 1991-1993 (n=216) and 2009-2013 (n=375)
finding: Over a 20-year period, women with GDM were older, more obese, and had a higher prevalence of hypertensive disorders and cesarean sections, while neonatal outcomes remained similar.
mod_finding: This study investigated characteristics of women with GDM and did not specifically focus on mode of delivery.
